calls.statement:
WITH date_range AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label
  FROM dim_date d
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 52
),
sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    d.fiscal_period_label,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 52
    AND p.category = 'Garden'
    AND s.store_id < 900  -- exclude web shop and training store
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label
),
returns AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    d.fiscal_period_label,
    SUM(r.refund_net) AS return_amount
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 52
    AND p.category = 'Garden'
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(s.fiscal_year, r.fiscal_year) AS fiscal_year,
  COALESCE(s.fiscal_period, r.fiscal_period) AS fiscal_period,
  COALESCE(s.fiscal_period_label, r.fiscal_period_label) AS fiscal_period_label,
  COALESCE(s.net_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS net_sales
FROM sales s
FULL OUTER JOIN returns r 
  ON s.fiscal_period = r.fiscal_period 
  AND s.fiscal_year = r.fiscal_year
ORDER BY COALESCE(s.fiscal_period, r.fiscal_period)
